title: Revise decision-sets and defaults-loop designs per review 1 section 6
summary: Edit the two design docs to apply all eight section-6 changes of review 1, settling F1–F4 (reader cap and runtime budget check, store for typed default fields, host-error record and landing trigger, one evidence standard and D87 enforcement fix) before the rest. The review file stays unchanged; no code is touched.

defaults_applied.how: Changes are design revisions with alternatives, for later review.
New claims cite files read or are labeled estimate.
One focused change limited to the two design docs.
F1–F4 settled first as the root issues before dependent edits.
Plain text written for an outside reader.

assumptions: The pair 'reaches accept' by addressing every section 6 item in the two designs; a fresh review is out of scope.
F2 resolves to a separate typed record keyed by default id, or to new optional defaults.toml keys deferred to a governance job; the producer picks one and records alternatives.
D90's stale 'section 9' reference lives in docs/decisions.md, which is an accepted log; it is noted in the designs as a correction needed rather than edited, unless editing is allowed.
Items needing probes of the gateway (multi-question call) are written as pre-build requirements, not performed.

acceptance_criteria.text: F1 is settled in decision-sets.md: the reader gets sets only through code-side class/phase narrowing with a stated cap, not the whole set; a new runtime per-job set-size check is named as a build item with its own test; the per-job 'User defaults that apply' brief section is given a budget or declared unbudgeted; defaults are stated not to count against producer/verifier budgets today.
Both designs replace 'refused by code' for over-budget sets (decision-sets.md §3, defaults-loop.md §2 R2) with wording that says the refusal is a test, not a job-time check.

F2: one store is chosen for assumptions and signals of defaults (defaults.toml keys via a governance job, or a separate typed record keyed by default id), and athena.defaults-proposal/1 in defaults-loop.md §8.1 gains the fields.

F3: a host-error record is specified with a status-code field, operation and job, written by the client; landing and host errors are added as watcher and introspection triggers (defaults-loop.md §3.1); the sentence saying rejections have no record is corrected to cite OutcomeState::Rejected.

F4: one evidence rule is stated (a single event puts a decision under review; N=3 distinct jobs governs adding a default), the 'repeats' sentence in decision-sets.md §5 is made consistent, and the D87 worked example's enforcement is changed from code-check to a brief/design kind.

F5/J2–J5: the designs state which matching parts are shared and which differ; choose one question shape for set membership; define the boolean threshold as the probability of the 'match/apply' option, not p_top; extend the defaults-loop.md §5 stored-field list for host-error and check records (no stderr from other jobs); name the 'request summary' field; require probing a multi-question call before the client is written.
J6: defaults-loop.md §10 extends the labeled set, scoring and promotion criteria to set membership and signal match.

F6/F7/F8: the class vocabulary is closed (or landing is stated as phase-only); decisions_matched is added to athena.introspection/1; a no-recursion rule says a firing's introspection is not watched, and host-error/check-failure observed interventions do not count toward N; the under-review store is named and recorded as a versioned, hashed brief component.

F9 corrections in the two designs: the D89/changelog wording and the '12 entries' migration claim, the D01–D90 vs D91 count, §7 item 8's citation of the log header, and the 1,500-token estimate for defaults render(); both documents' status lines are updated to reflect the revision.
docs/design/reviews/decision-sets-review-1.md is byte-for-byte unchanged and no file under crates/, defaults.toml, or records/ is modified (git diff --stat shows only design docs).
Run `git status` and `git diff --stat`: only files under docs/ (and optionally CHANGELOG.md) appear, and the review file is absent from the diff.

out_of_scope: Any code, tests or defaults.toml changes
Running the first build of review section 5
departures: Slightly higher cost than reference because the two long design docs must be read and edited across eight cross-linked changes.
